rejects.problem: The accepted alternative '¿Lo puedo probar?' means 'Can I try it?' (test/taste), not 'Can I try it on?'. Without the reflexive pronoun 'me', the meaning changes and does not match the English.
rejects.fix: Remove '¿Lo puedo probar?' from the accepted alternatives.
